instruction: Move the rectangular playingcards case with patterns to the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, then shift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.

source.instruction: Move the rectangular playingcards case with patterns to the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, then shift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the object, which was at x = -23 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the basket, which was at x = +2 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm forward and right toward (-24, 0, 94), orienting gripper downward to align with the cards.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+6, +19, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, -1, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm vertically to pre-grasp height around z = 84.5 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-23, -1, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Descend to z = 77.5 cm over the cards case and close the gripper to grasp it.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the object; closed the gripper (opening 0.64: holding the object)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-23, 0, 78) opening 0.64; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift cards case up to z = 93 cm to clear table level.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +15) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, 1, 93) opening 0.65; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust left arm yaw slightly by -15 degrees for transport.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, 1, 93) opening 0.65; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point gripper forward, lift slightly to z = 98.5 cm, and move right toward the basket.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+9, +7, +8) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +1 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-14, 7, 100) opening 0.64; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Translate left arm right and back to align over basket opening, rotate yaw -90 degrees.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+12, -5, -0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +1 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, 3, 100) opening 0.65; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower cards case slightly into the basket down to z = 94.5 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+1, -2, -5) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +1 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-1, 1, 94) opening 0.65; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Open left gripper to release the cards into the yellow basket.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +18 cm (vertical) from the object; opened the gripper

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-1, 1, 94) opening 0.92; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Retract left arm to home position and reposition right arm to grasp basket handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-29, -20, -0) cm, now 35 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the basket; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-14, -0, +0) cm, now 20 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the basket

frames.label: turn 11
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm toward the basket handle at (2, -6, 92.5).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-14, +13, -1) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +18 cm (vertical) from the basket

frames.label: turn 12
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (2, -6, 93) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower slightly to z = 91 cm and close gripper onto the basket handle.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -2) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the basket; closed the gripper (opening 0.34: holding the basket)

frames.label: turn 13
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (2, -6, 91) opening 0.34; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift basket slightly by moving z +2 cm to shift it.
